name: activate_state_change_control
description: This skill activates a visible control element on the page.
precondition: The control is visible and interactable.

execution_plan.fallback: try to locate the control again or refresh the page
execution_plan.success_check: verify that the state change has occurred

name: fill_visible_field
description: Fill a visible input field with the specified value.
precondition: The input field is visible and ready for input.

execution_plan.fallback: scroll to the input field and try again
execution_plan.success_check: verify that the input field contains the input_value

name: submit_search_query
description: This skill allows the user to submit a search query using a designated input field and a control button.
precondition: The search input field and button are visible and enabled.

execution_plan.target_desc: the input field for the search query
execution_plan.fallback: try to locate the input field again
execution_plan.success_check: verify that the input field contains the search query

execution_plan.target_desc: the button to submit the search query
execution_plan.fallback: try to locate the search button again
execution_plan.success_check: verify that the search results are displayed
